Concurrent depth=2 crawl correctly fans out and deduplicates across levels

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_concurrent\":3,\"max_depth\":2}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
```
